notes.title: Add tutorial and adjust zombie perception ability
notes.notes:
1. Add novice tutorials to strengthen guidance
2. Increasing the setting of gunfire will attract more zombies. Continuous shooting will lead to endless zombies.
3. Adjust the perception ability of zombies to make it easier for zombies to spot players from the front.
4. Nerfed shotguns
5. Adjust the color of the game screen to be closer to the original color

notes.title: New Vehicle System; Add durability for weapon & equipment & food
notes.notes:
Updates are as follows:
1. Added new vehicle system
2. Increase weapon durability, equipment durability, and food freshness settings
2. Modify the zombie’s attack reaction and animation
3. Fix mission system BUG
4. Adjust item generation probability and price

Zombies can be hit by light hits or heavy hits. Heavy hits have a knockback effect, which is determined by the direction of the attack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992463/a70b8c273b81941f29949426a8deb7573aad20d6.png[/img]

Vehicles require gasoline to run and can hit zombies. They will be damaged after their durability returns to zero. Damage requires a toolbox to repair.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992463/39d4b8a3177e0c218d8a4150ada7a37ef47f3c6d.png[/img]

Weapons and equipment have durability. Attacking and being attacked both consume durability, and can be decomposed. Decomposition will return part of the production materials. Food has freshness. Try to collect a lot of food in the early stage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992463/c7d0e7c1444d340efcab3d0dc808bf61fc83d38c.png[/img]

notes.title: Survive Ten Days v.1.0
notes.notes:
We have finally completed the first playable version, below are the game description and operation instructions, the game is still in beta stage

If you are interested, you can join the QQ group: 960907296, thank you!

[b]Game background[/b]
[list]
[*] Players play the role of a few survivors in the apocalypse and try their best to survive longer.
[*] As time goes by, the rate of zombie generation will increase, reaching its peak after 10 days.
[*] Advanced special zombies will be randomly refreshed. These zombies are highly threatening, please pay more attention to them.
[*] After the house/base is cleared, it will turn into a safe state and no zombies will be generated in the short term.
[*] All materials will be automatically refreshed after 2 days of searching, and camp tasks will also be refreshed after 2 days.
[*] Faction bases can be traded. Completing tasks can increase favorability. When the favorability reaches 100, NPCs can be controlled. Hostile camps will launch attacks.
[*] The camp population will disappear when it reaches 0, and will be randomly repopulated in a safe base after that.
[/list]

[b]Character[/b]
[list]
[*] Character professions can be freely chosen, and each profession has different skill focuses.
[*] Each character can choose up to three personalities, and the character's appearance can be customized
[*] Each character has different initial equipment, but the initial weapons are all pistols
[/list]

[b]Operating instructions[/b]
[list]
[*] Movement: WASD movement, Shirt key to run, space bar to climb, Ctrl to crouch/recover to stand
[*] Viewing angle: Hold down the left mouse button to rotate the viewing angle, and use the mouse wheel to zoom in and out.
[*] Interaction: Pointing the mouse at an interactive item will highlight the object/character. Press and hold E to open the box, and short press E to engage in character dialogue.
[*] Items: The I key can recall the backpack, the M key can open the map, and the number 123 key can quickly select the corresponding weapon.
[*] Combat: After equipping a weapon, press the right button of the mouse to enter aiming mode, and the left button of the mouse to attack
[*] Others: Press the F key to turn on the flashlight
[/list]
